bibliographic.title: Credited Conversation
bibliographic.author: mrehl
bibliographic.description:
My second attempt at playing with Twine. Inspired by the Dialogue Jam hosted by manonamora, Autumn Chen, Lapin Lunaire Games, I sat down and learned the basics of how text adventures work. Far from the best story ever told, I tried to at least add my twist to how these things are done.

Recursive in the worst way, the ending is more than open-ended.

However, I'm happy to say that I did it!
